scope: Real Linux daemon, CLI, output and host-call streams, and published Python/Kotlin SDKs on Docker Desktop; functional acceptance before the full L9 checkpoint
queueCoverage: Finite-slot and per-shell FIFO with one bounded waiting count
Queue timeout retains no-execution refusal and never starts when capacity recovers
Queued cancellation preserves active work; forget and ID reuse never dispatch stale payloads
Commands queue during startup; expiry and parent closure cancel pending child work
Shutdown contains active work; new epochs never replay old payloads
Terminal retention starts after queue completion; kept refusals remain available
CLI, output events and host-call final streams observe queued outcomes
Published Python SDK default and named contexts wait, expire and cancel queued work; both published SDK conformance flows pass
